summary: CVE-2026-93515 affecting package xorg-x11-server-Xwayland for versions less than 24.1.14-1
details: A use-after-free in present_clear_window_notifies()  in the X.org X Server before 21.1.25 and X Wayland before 24.1.14 could be used by malicious X clients to crash or potentially execute code in the X server context.
